content.rendered:
Yearbooks:  


Pre-purchased yearbooks will be handed out during 6th period on June 9th.
Extra books will be available for sale in the front office starting June 12th for $25.00


8th Graders:

June 15th – last day for 8th grade
  • 8:00 – 8:45:  Promotion Practice
  • 8:45 – 2:30:  Oaks Park


June 16th  – 8th Grade Promotion 

  • No school for 8th graders
  • 3:40 – Students arrive to pick up promotion gown
  • 4:00 – 5:00:  Promotion  
  • 5:30 – 7:30:  Dance with SMS @ SHS (parents provide transportation)

6th & 7th Graders:

June 16th – last day
  • Move-it Up Day & Field Day
  • Release at 11:50
